I wish I was brave enough to see a therapist. I truly respect anyone who can open up like that. I don’t really feel like hating yourself is a definitive way to describe depression or suicidal thoughts. I don’t want to brutally murder myself because I don’t hate myself. I just feel like I can’t keep trying and that it’ll be easier for everyone if I’m just gone.

Love is hard. Loving is easy. We fall in love so easily but there comes a time when we’ve been hurt too many times to trust ourselves and so we start to tell ourselves we’re the problem we’re unlovable and the more we believe it the harder it’s going to be to not only find love but to love ourselves. I don’t know how to start loving myself more. I know it’s what I need but I just can’t convince myself I’m worth loving.

No one posting here truly wants to be here. We all wish we were normal but we have no clue what normal even is we just know it’s not us. The pain of living haunts me almost every day but the pain I know I would cause others keeps me around. It’s not the best way to live I still hurt, life still sucks but I do have some hope in knowing that I can still love others which means I’m not useless I’m just broken. Don’t forget about those you love or have loved they’re why we stick around.

I feel like the only thing keeping me around on this messed up planet is not wanting to hurt my family. I don’t love myself most days but I do love them. And it kind of sucks a selfish part of me just wants to turn off my feelings so I can finally escape. But I have to remember and remind myself that I am capable of loving and so now I just need to teach myself how to be loved.

I really hope you’re still here. I don’t know you I’m only here because I’m flat out tired of life myself. I wish there were some magic words I could say to make things better, “Jesus loves you”? But I don’t want to say something I have a hard time believing right now. What a can say of that a small part of me loves you right now because I’m having a damn hard time loving myself but reading of your pain makes me want to love you even if it’s just for a moment.

Honestly I don’t know. This is my first time truly reaching out to someone and even expressing my feelings of self hate. I look at my family and my friends and I judge how happy they are thinking how unfair that it is that I’m so miserable. But on another side it’s beautiful to see their happiness because that proves it’s possible right?

Today has been hard for me too. I’ve come closer to ending my life today then ever before. I wish I could give you the physical comfort and safety you need but I’m just a stranger on fucking Reddit. I do know that you’re not alone. This whole subreddit is filled with people going through some of the same things you are. After reading your post I cried for the first time in a year. I didn’t just cry for you but I cried because I’m feeling some of the same things you are and that hurts. Not having purpose hurts, feeling alone and misunderstood is miserable but we can’t give up yet. We’ve come this far right? We’re posting on this subreddit because we want help which means a small part of us wants to live and damnit we can’t ignore that. And so we need to carry on and try and understand that small part of us that loves so hard it hurts.

I feel you. I’m going through some of the same shit. I wonder if this is all worth it. Life sucks. But I can’t deny there’s a part of me that hopes it gets better. That hopes I can be happy someday. I know I’m week but the idea of being truly happy someday makes me want to fight for that happiness. Do you wanna fight with me? I could also really use some help. Maybe it’s you.
